peergrade_reviews.feedback: Cool creative idea, really liked the overlapping of the voices, it delivers the message in a clear, concise way and I think you absolutely nailed that part! Although it has a lot of potential, I believe the sound variety could be more "colorful" (as in more noises and sound effects alongside the voices), and maybe more variety in the type/acting of voice (optional, I just think it would sound cooler). Cool radio ad, overall! P.S: I think you forgot to submit the file with the script. I just happened to notice, I don't know if it was intentional or not!

The message of the commercial is, in my opinion, rather clear, indicating that the Active Noise Cancellation of the Sony Earbuds is a killer feature by activating it in the middle of a huge crowd of people discussing. The voice acting was also, in my opinion, on point, making the commercial engaging. In regards to the audio editing, I believe it was very well executed, especially the idea of constantly increasing the volume of the crowd to increase the impact of turning it all off with ANC. Overall, great submission!

As much as I like the concept and the execution of it, it does all boil down to the discrepancy with the duration. I can't in good conscious give this a 2 since I really like what is here, but it is still something to be mentioned. Otherwise, and disregarding the time criteria, this is a snappy, efficient and to the point execution on the concept

I think the concept of a crowded atmosphere is really nice and makes it a cool ad, but the transition to it could be more gradual.
